packetAudit.purpose: Independently verify actual paper, material geometry and result bindings without changing source, geometry or solver.
packetAudit.mode: Passive observation of paper/done packets produced by actual UI operations; typed arrays serialized as arrays in the evidence.
packetAudit.materialIdentityPolicy: Source and baked initial fixtures remain pinned. Every live result uses independently recomputed actual hashes, protected geometry and mesh checks; no universal Node material byte golden is assumed.

limits: Automated functional and viewport checks only; screenshots require separate visual review.
390 px is a responsive viewport check, not a mobile-device performance or touch certification.

Two complete real solves: 20/0 mm expected pass and 100/-40 mm browser-observed cloth-intersection candidate. Every run must observe its own actual failure, never assume it. This does not certify the parameter domain.
